dataset: Central Athens relief grid for Politeia
source: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles (Mapzen), terrarium encoding, zoom 14
requiredAttribution: Europe terrain data produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union - EU-DEM layers
United States 3DEP (formerly NED) and global GMTED2010 and SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
attributionNote: The source documentation lists the full required notice for all providers; the lines above are those relevant to Greece plus Mapzen for the hosted tiles.
limitations: The source resolution is roughly 30 m and it is a surface model, so roofs and trees can raise it locally; a light smoothing is applied.
Sharp rock edges such as the Acropolis cliffs and the Lycabettus summit are rounded and somewhat lower than in reality.
Building heights are placed on top of this relief at the lowest ground point of each footprint; they are not re-measured.
Outside the extract the lab fades the relief to the base level; that margin is visual context only.
